newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO SAYS UPPED LANSIVOIMA STAKE TO 44 PCT.
newsitem.headline: IVO SAYS UPPED LANSIVOIMA STAKE TO 44 PCT.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power group ~Imatran Voima Oy~ (IVO) on Wednesday bought over 800,000 shares in electricity grid operator Lansivoima Oy raising its ownership stake to about 44 percent from 31.5 percent, an IVO spokesman told Reuters by telephone.
"We have been buying. We are behind the two big blocks," the spokesman said in response to a question.
On the Helsinki bourse, Merita Securities transacted two big blocks of Lansivoima shares in-house -- one of 618,599 shares and another of 219,218 shares -- all at 220.00 markka each.
IVO's stake in Lansivoima rose to "about 44 percent", the spokesman said, adding IVO would release a statement about the acquisition.
